trigger.note: ST85 (paid base reel spin, skin 1) triggers the LockFreespin feature via ReMarks='Trigger' (294/40000 in-sample). ST86 is the granted free reel spin (skin 2, ReMarks='FreeSpin' x2123; re-trigger 'TriggerAddFreeSpin' x566 grants additional free spins). CostCredits=1000 is a per-record ECHO, not an actual deduction: ST86 shares the SAME SpinTimes group as its triggering ST85 (e.g. SpinTimes=33 across the Trigger spin + all following ST86 rounds) and LastCredits only INCREASES (wins) across the free-spin sequence, never decreases — the payment unit is the SpinTimes group, not the record (M104 echo pattern). Both STs settle via their NATIVE PayoutIdToWinAmount payids — sum(payid)==WinCredits on EVERY win round (10819/10819 ST85, 2121/2121 ST86) — no synthesized pid needed. No live collect channel: SymbolIndexToRewards/CollectCount/CreditsSymbols all absent; RewardLastNode is a payline-node list (e.g. ['29-'], ['27-']) mirroring the payid keys, NOT a ticking collect counter. Server FeatureWin taxonomy = {LockFreespinNormal (base contribution), LockFreespin (feature)}; LockReels field present (1.0) but empty in-sample.

validation.evidence: W1+W4 (onboard-implementer, 2026-06-18; 40000 ST85 + 2689 ST86 rounds across 1 real _cache_version:3 chunk chunk_0002, 8 robots, single config bucket 8f5b76b3/4c03f461, _bet=1000): ST inventory = 2 SpinTypes, both STANDARD full-reel signature (StopSymbolsByCol+PayoutByPayline+PayoutIdToWinAmount+RewardLastNode+ReelSkin+ReMarks+WinCredits, all 18 observed fields present 1.0 on both). Field-signature MATCH with the confirmed-archetype sibling M95 (identical 2-ST topology: paid base + free reel spin, identical 18-field schema, both settle natively). STRICT-REUSE of the generic per-ST plugins: ST85 role=paid_spin/Normal (CostCredits=1000, GameplayTriggerType=0 on 100%, ReMarks empty x39706 except 'Trigger' x294 -> opens LockFreespin); ST86 role=freespin/LockFreespin (granted free reel spin on skin 2, CostCredits=1000 is a per-record echo only — same SpinTimes group as the triggering ST85, LastCredits monotonically non-decreasing across the free sequence; ReMarks='FreeSpin' x2123 / 'TriggerAddFreeSpin' x566 re-trigger). FeatureWin taxonomy = {LockFreespinNormal, LockFreespin}. NO live-collect channel (SymbolIndexToRewards/CollectCount/CreditsSymbols absent on 100%); RewardLastNode is a payline-node list mirroring payid keys, NOT a ticking collect counter. EVERY win round carries a populated native PayoutIdToWinAmount with sum(payid)==WinCredits -> ZERO win-without-payid (0/10819 ST85, 0/2121 ST86) -> no additive collect residual, no _unattributed_residual. CurJackpotStoreWin present on 100% of rounds but =0 on 100% (test-interface-zeroed, fleet-wide behavior). Both STs supportable manifest-only via the generic PER_SPINTYPE plugins (paid_spin) + the existing freespin_dynamics plugin (freespin role, already validated/wired). NO new plugin, NO synth rule, NO wiring change, NO frontend dimension change (freespin role + _stDim already in framework). rtp_integrity.paid_st=[85] (ST86 is a free spin -> excluded from the RTP denominator despite its CostCredits echo). Awaiting onboard-tester + breaker + user domain sign-off (gate 8).

out_of_engine_mechanics.name: CurJackpotStoreWin progressive (test-interface-zeroed)
out_of_engine_mechanics.desc: Field 'CurJackpotStoreWin' is present on every ST85/ST86 round but =0 on 100% of in-sample records (42689/42689). FLEET-WIDE test-interface behavior (user-confirmed 2026-06-12, M275 gate 8): a real progressive jackpot store whose accumulation efficiency the CURRENT testspin interface forces to 0 (so the sample correctly shows 0). Parse as-is with the progressive contributing 0; the field is already in the ST85/ST86 signature, so parsing is FORWARD-COMPATIBLE — when the test interface is optimized to populate it, the existing parser picks it up unchanged. The data RTP is the BASE RTP (excludes the progressive); the progressive ADDS on top once the interface enables it.
